aliases: Wi-Fi IP Plug In 4K Spotlight Camera with 2-Way Audio and Audio Alerts and Siren
features: microSD or Night Owl recorder storage

frigate.notes: Night Owl cameras stream through the Night Owl DVR/NVR — point Frigate at the recorder's IP, one channel per camera: /ch01/0 (main) and /ch01/1 (sub), where 01 is the channel number. No direct-to-camera ONVIF/RTSP. RTSP path from the community RTSP-patterns layer (issue #268).

release_notes: Night Owl CAM-WNIP8LBU: a plug-in Wi-Fi 4K spotlight camera with two-way audio, audio alerts and a siren. Consumer product-page specs — Night Owl does not publish sensor/lens details; unlisted fields omitted, form-factor from the product listing.
